newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Timber Master to buy African timber firm.
newsitem.headline: Timber Master to buy African timber firm.

text.p: Malaysia's Timber Master Industries Bhd said on Monday it had agreed to acquire 100 percent interest in Bois Et Scierie Du Gabon (BSG) from Dushan Holdings Ltd for $17.6 million in cash.

BSG, a private company incorporated in Gabon, is principally involved in forestry exploitation, sawmilling and trading of wood. It currently owns a total concession area of 220,770 hectares. The concession has been granted forestry permits for the purpose of extraction of timber for sale.
Timber Master said in a statement the purchase will be financed by bank borrowings and internal generated funds.

It said that as the availability of logs in Malaysia and Asia-Pacific is generally restricted due to tightening governmental controls and higher levies, it has become necessary for Timber Master to secure long term log supplies for its factories in Malaysia.
Timber Master also viewed the acquisition as an attractive investment as BSG is a profitable business with strong prospects of expanding into manufacturing.
